responsibility: Declares the StrCase API for converting fixed strings and single characters between upper and lower case. This header exposes focused ASCII case-mapping services for callers that do not need the broader string-manipulation or dynamic-string facilities provided by neighboring modules.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GStrCase.cc by presenting only the StrCase API signatures for string and character case conversion. It omits the buffer-walking implementation and explicit ASCII upper/lower mapping code that live in the .cc file.
